# FlutterReleases

> Independent Flutter SDK release reference containing Flutter versions, bundled Dart versions, release dates, downloads, compatibility information, and official source links.

## Core

- Flutter Versions: https://flutterreleases.com/flutter-versions/
- Flutter/Dart Compatibility Checker: https://flutterreleases.com/tools/flutter-version-checker/
- Complete Release Dataset: https://flutterreleases.com/releases.json
- FAQ: https://flutterreleases.com/faq/

## Current Releases

- Latest Stable Flutter 3.47.4 (Dart 3.13.3): https://flutterreleases.com/release/3.47.4/
- Latest Stable Flutter Markdown: https://flutterreleases.com/release/3.47.4.md
- Latest Beta Flutter 3.48.0-0.5.pre (Dart 3.14.0): https://flutterreleases.com/release/3.48.0-0.5.pre/

- Blog: https://flutterreleases.com/blog/
- Full LLM Reference: https://flutterreleases.com/llms-full.txt
